<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 121.0528, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈120.045 Da. The formula that matches this mass and the observed isotopic pattern best is C₄H₈O₄.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
